factsSkipped.note: Checked thealibiroom.com/menus and web search for a whole-pie price; the menu page only exposed an appetizer ($14.25 cheese bread) before truncating, and no review stated a pizza price (one aggregator showed only a vague '$$' symbol), so priceIndex stays unconfirmed.

Seattle Met and West Seattle Blog both reported a November 12, 2017 opening in search snippets, but both pages returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch so I could not read the stated date myself; Seattle Mag's Dec 18, 2017 piece calls Supreme only 'new' without giving a date, which isn't enough to confirm an opening year.
